review_candidates.title: Customer Service Representative
review_candidates.description: Job Description We keep on growing. Grow with us! At Mouser Electronics, Inc., we are looking for team players who thrive in a fast-paced, international environment and enjoy variety in their day-to-day work. Join our Vilnius Customer Service Team and play a key role in bringing our business forward and contributing to our continued success. Customer Service Representative (f/m/d) What To Expect The Customer Service Representative is responsible for providing the highest level of service to customers by processing orders, quotes and assisting customers with catalog information, always maintaining and exhibiting Mouser values to each and every customer. Generates new and repeat business through customer service initiatives. Accurately processes customer transactions such as orders, quotes or returns with a strong focus on service excellence. Follows up with customers to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and to resolve any customer concerns that may arise. Provides information regarding availability of in-stock and out-of-stock items. Provides customers with cross-selling and up-selling opportunities, and offers associated products and promotional items. Researches and expedites customer orders. Monitors and ensures delivery date and product quality to meet customer requirements; verifies customer orders are processed correctly. Confirms special handling orders are expedited. Fills requests for catalogs, information or samples. Supports local Customer Service teams, and provides support for other teams when needed. Other duties as assigned What We Are Looking For 1-2 years’ experience in a customer service role, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Strong ability and desire to provide excellent customer service and to promote and maintain high standards of quality. Maintains a high level of commitment to achieve goals and has the desire and ability to deal directly with customers and represent Mouser Electronics. Professional verbal and written communication skills in Lithuanian and English; professional language skills in Russian are an advantage. Proficient in MS Office; experience with other systems are a plus. Understands and able to correctly work with multiple currencies and other requirements with regard to processing international orders. Exhibits strong analytical skills, problem solving and negotiation skills, and analyzes the impact of decisions before execution. Demonstrates profound planning and organization skills and works very structured. Accountable and integer, energetic personality. Self-motivated and result-oriented and a good team worker (cross-cultural). Takes initiative to expand knowledge for position utilizing all available sources What We Offer A long-term perspective with responsible tasks and attractive development opportunities in a dynamic team. You can also expect: A modern, central office space Permanent employment contract 25 days of annual leave increasing with seniority Special Leave allowance for doctor appointments Health insurance A wide range of training and development opportunities through our Mouser University Employee referral bonus program Complimentary fruit and beverages at the workplace Regular staff events Our Office Is Located At The Following Address Mouser Electronics Konstitucijos pr.15-88, LT-09319 Vilnius Lithuania The salary range for this position is EUR 1,750 - EUR 2,100. About Us Mouser Electronics, founded in 1964, is a globally authorized distributor of semiconductors and electronic components for over 1,200 industry-leading manufacturer brands. This year marks the company's 60th anniversary. We specialize in the rapid introduction of the newest products and technologies targeting the design engineer and buyer communities. Mouser has 28 offices located around the globe. We conduct business in 23 different languages and 34 currencies. Our global distribution centre is equipped with state-of-the-art wireless warehouse management systems that enable us to process orders 24/7, and deliver nearly perfect pick-and-ship operations.

review_candidates.title: Consolidation Manager
review_candidates.description: For one of our clients - an international company based in Geneva (airport) - we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager to strengthen its Finance team. In this strategic role, you will lead the group consolidation process, ensure the accuracy of financial reporting, and support the delivery of high-quality financial information in compliance with IFRS and local statutory requirements. Responsibilities Lead the monthly, quarterly and annual group consolidation process. Prepare and review consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting across multiple entities. Manage financial accounting and reporting activities under IFRS, Swiss GAAP and local statutory frameworks. Perform intercompany reconciliations and oversee the elimination of intragroup transactions. Coordinate month-end and year-end closings, including balance sheet reviews and multi-currency reconciliations. Analyze financial results, investigate variances, and provide meaningful insights to management. Support external and internal audits and maintain a strong internal control environment. Oversee statutory reporting obligations and liaise with local finance teams. Contribute to treasury-related activities, including cash-flow reporting, liquidity monitoring, and foreign exchange exposure analysis. Support tax reporting and compliance requirements in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Drive continuous improvements in consolidation, reporting processes and financial systems. Profile University degree in Finance, Accounting, Audit. +7/ 10 years of experience in group consolidation, financial reporting or audit within an international environment. Strong knowledge of IFRS and exposure to Swiss GAAP. Proven experience with consolidation tools such as Magnitude or Hyperion. Strong understanding of multi-entity and multi-currency environments. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with international stakeholders. Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

review_candidates.description: JOB DESCRIPTION PLAN INTERNATIONAL – Cluster Director South America Location: Ecuador, Paraguay, or Peru Work authorization: Candidates must already have legal authorization to work in the country from which they apply. Languages: Fluent English and Spanish (written and spoken). English is non-negotiable. Contract: Permanent, local contract with Plan International Reports to: Regional Director Travel: Approximately 50% regional travel About Plan International Plan International is a global humanitarian and development organization, active for over 85 years in more than 80 countries, dedicated to advancing children’s rights and gender equality, with a particular focus on girls affected by poverty, discrimination, exclusion, and violence. The Opportunity Plan International is seeking a senior international development/humanitarian executive to serve as Cluster Director South America . This is not primarily a technical programme or project-management position . It is a senior organizational leadership role with responsibility for providing strategic direction across multiple Country Offices and supporting and holding senior country leadership accountable for organizational performance. The Cluster Director will lead the Cluster Management Team, work closely with Country Representatives, and provide leadership across strategy, programmes, humanitarian action, people and culture, finance, business development, risk, safeguarding, security and external positioning. The successful candidate will bring substantial experience leading at country, regional, or multi-country level within an international NGO, humanitarian organization, international development organization, UN agency, or closely comparable environment. Candidate Profile — Please Read Before Applying Given the seniority of this position, we are particularly interested in candidates whose experience demonstrates organizational leadership , rather than solely technical, project, consulting, sustainability/ESG, or functional leadership. The strongest candidates will have: 1. Senior Country / Regional Leadership Significant leadership experience in the international development or humanitarian sector Previous experience at a level comparable to Country Director, Country Representative, Deputy Country Director/Representative, Regional Director, Multi-Country Director, or another senior organizational leadership position Experience leading or providing strategic oversight across country offices, countries, or major organizational portfolios Experience managing and influencing senior leaders and multidisciplinary leadership teams Demonstrated accountability for organizational performance beyond a single technical programme or project Experience leading geographically dispersed and multicultural teams 2. International NGO / Humanitarian Experience Strong understanding of how international NGOs, humanitarian organizations, UN agencies, or comparable international development organizations operate Experience working within complex international or matrixed organizational structures Strong understanding of international development programming and humanitarian action Experience working with vulnerable populations and rights-based approaches Knowledge of child rights, gender equality and gender-transformative programming is highly valued Experience in humanitarian response, preparedness, migration, displacement, protection or crisis-affected environments is highly desirable 3. Executive & Organizational Accountability Candidates should demonstrate substantial responsibility across several of the following areas: Organizational or country strategy Large and/or multidisciplinary teams Significant budgets and financial performance Resource mobilization and business development Institutional donor relationships and compliance Risk and organizational governance People and culture Safeguarding Programme quality and impact Organizational transformation/change External representation Experience limited primarily to managing individual projects or technical portfolios, without broader organizational leadership accountability, is unlikely to meet the requirements of this role. 4. Donor Engagement & External Representation Demonstrated experience representing an organization with governments, institutional donors, UN agencies, INGOs, civil society and strategic partners Strong experience in resource mobilization, donor engagement and/or business development Understanding of donor compliance, funding pipelines and financial sustainability Strong diplomacy, negotiation and influencing capability Credibility representing Plan International at senior national and regional levels 5. Regional / Multi-Country Perspective Demonstrated experience operating across multiple countries or within a regional structure Ability to understand different political, cultural, economic and organizational contexts Experience supporting or influencing country-level leadership from a regional or multi-country position is particularly valued Knowledge of South America—particularly Ecuador, Paraguay and/or Peru —is highly desirable Essential Requirements Candidates should apply only if they can demonstrate: Relevant university degree Substantial senior leadership experience in international development, humanitarian action, an international NGO, UN agency, or closely comparable organization Country-level, regional, or multi-country organizational leadership experience Experience leading senior, multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams Strong strategic and organizational management capability Understanding of development and humanitarian programming Strong external representation and stakeholder-management experience Experience with donors, resource mobilization and financial accountability Commitment to child rights, gender equality, safeguarding, inclusion and rights-based development Full professional fluency in English and Spanish Particularly Relevant Backgrounds We strongly encourage applications from professionals who currently hold or have previously held positions such as: Country Director | Country Representative | Deputy Country Director | Deputy Representative | Regional Director | Multi-Country Director | Regional Programme Director | Regional Operations Director | Humanitarian Director | Senior Regional Leadership roles within international NGOs, humanitarian organizations, UN agencies, international development organizations or comparable institutions. Key Responsibilities Set the strategic direction of the South America Cluster Support and hold Country Representatives accountable for strategy, performance and organizational effectiveness Lead the Cluster Management Team and ensure functional areas effectively support Country Offices Strengthen development and humanitarian programming across the cluster Oversee cluster-level performance, budgets, risk, compliance and resource allocation Drive resource mobilization, business development and long-term sustainability Ensure safeguarding, security, gender equality and inclusion are embedded across strategies and operations Strengthen emergency preparedness and humanitarian-response capacity Represent Plan International with governments, donors, UN agencies, civil society, media and peer organizations Build strategic partnerships and strengthen Plan International’s positioning across South America Lead organizational change and contribute actively to regional leadership across the Americas Application Process Candidates must have legal authorization to work in Ecuador, Paraguay, or Peru . Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a formal application through Plan International’s recruitment platform. The selection process may include executive interviews, psychometric assessments, reference checks, background checks and additional executive-level assessments. Commitment to Equality, Diversity & Safeguarding Equality, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of everything Plan International stands for. Plan International is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, empowered and able to contribute fully. Plan International operates with zero tolerance for abuse, exploitation, harassment, discrimination, fraud, bribery and corruption. Pre-employment checks will be conducted in line with Plan International’s Safeguarding Children and Young People policy and the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. Plan International will never request payment from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process.

review_candidates.title: Business Development and Partnerships Manager
review_candidates.description: About Skyscanner Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻. Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍. Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here). Now, we’re on the lookout for a Business Development and Partnerships Manager to help us bring that vision to even more travellers. About The Role (Hybrid) As the Business Development and Partnerships Manager joining our Affiliate and Performance Partnerships team, you will thrive on building meaningful partnerships and thinking big picture for our program. You will lean into data-led decision-making, be adaptable to our enterprise partners' needs, and have strong commercial awareness. This role requires a strong negotiator with experience managing complex partner relationships. What You’ll Be Doing Sales / Negotiations - You are a sales and negotiation expert. You love working with partners and know how to find value in those relationships that works for everyone. Big picture thinker - You are a creative and big-picture thinker – nothing is impossible. Forward thinker - You are an early adopter and like to be ahead of the competition – you look for partners that share those values. Partnership Management - Own and manage a portfolio of current partnerships by quickly building personal relationships with our global enterprise-sized partnerships and assessing opportunities to grow revenue. Reporting / Insights - Provide consistent reporting and insights to external partners as well as internal stakeholders. Data-driven decisions - Leverage internal data, partner insights, market trends, and the competitive landscape to make data-driven recommendations for perpetual improvements Tech knowledge - Continually researching and understanding the global travel tech environment to ensure that we remain at the forefront of the industry. Industry knowledge - Conduct competitive intelligence scans/benchmarking and develop strategies to adapt to changing environment within the travel vertical Partner growth - Lead and assist in negotiating media placements, collaborations, and exclusives with key partners Commercial - Identify and initiate new ideas, incentives and bonus structures to achieve and exceed performance goals About You Sales / Partner management experience - Strong sales, negotiation and partnership management skills – knowing the travel tech space is a plus Business Development - Demonstrated success conducting outreach and recruiting for new performance-based marketing partners and relationships Technical partner integration experience - Deep technical skills and the ability to talk product: knowledge on APIs, feeds, widgets, etc Team player / Autonomous - Ambitious, results-driven individual who enjoys working as a team but can also thrive independently Analytical - Able to analyse data and determine partner or market success focused around ROI Commercial understanding - Commercial outlook, negotiation and experience of managing 3rd parties Relationship builder - You love people. You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with hundreds (if not thousands) of partners Business acumen - Strong business and marketing acumen with an ability to identify business opportunities, deliver results, and adjust plans as appropriate Tooling / Technologies / AI - Experience with management and tracking technologies used to measure performance and do business development What It's Like Here We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭. Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨. Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel. We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.
